title: Review an archive request with its evidence

nodes.label: Receive the request
nodes.quote: The coordinator records the requested collection and the research question.

nodes.label: Check the evidence
nodes.quote: The archivist checks the record against the collection catalogue.

nodes.label: Review access
nodes.quote: The access reviewer checks the annotated record against the collection's access conditions.

nodes.label: Return a traceable response
nodes.quote: The coordinator returns the decision with its supporting notes.

edges.label: Recorded request
edges.quote: Once the request is recorded, the coordinator passes the record to the archivist.

edges.label: Annotated record
edges.quote: After the catalogue check is complete, the archivist sends the annotated record to the access reviewer.

edges.label: Decision and notes
edges.quote: After the access review, the reviewer passes the decision and its supporting notes to the coordinator.
